rationale: A defensible composite of the archive's two strongest independent channels, but the double-subtraction of `dp` (once inside the cash leg's `oancf - dp`, once implicitly rewarded in the `dp/(at-act)` conditioner) creates an offsetting mechanical link that will partly cancel rather than reinforce the two effects, so the "complementarity" claim is weaker than stated.

This is a cosmetic smoothing variant of ConservativeDepreciationProfit (already at fmb_tstat 5.09, ls_talpha 3.30) with no new economic content — a three-year moving average of the same conditioner is exactly the kind of measurement tweak the objective asks researchers not to substitute for a substantive improvement.

The conditioner is identical to the already-tested RolloverRiskAdjustedProfit and the only change is subtracting `dp` a second time from an income measure that is already after depreciation — an arbitrary, uncalibrated stress charge that mostly re-ranks firms by capital intensity rather than by accounting conservatism, so it neither cleanly "internalizes" the gen-4 channel nor constitutes a distinct hypothesis.

A legitimate and cheap decomposition test of an untested cell (dltt/act) that discriminates between the callability and total-claim-burden mechanisms, though it is largely a component of the already-tested lt/act conditioner and the framing admits a null result is the informative outcome, which caps its standalone value.

A within-firm time-series position measure of leverage is a genuinely distinct object from every cross-sectional or one-year-change conditioner in the archive and plausibly nets out permanent business-model leverage, though the claim that it is the "only" untested construction is overstated and the five-year window's coverage cost needs watching.

A reasonable consolidation of the two highest-alpha ingredients, but dlc/act and the previously paired lt/act are components of the same liquidity-versus-claims construct, so the assumed imperfect correlation is optimistic and the likely outcome is a marginal rather than reinforcing gain.
